name: Henge Mastery
body:
Prerequisite(s): Jester level 5th, ability to bond with at least two henges

Benefit(s): Choose one henge you are bonded with.

You gain one additional power from that henge’s list of available powers. This power is in addition to the powers you normally gain from your henge bonds. You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must choose a different henge.
